issues.issue: Did the Board err by not deciding whether the applicant was a practising Christian?
issues.applicant_position: Board failed to rule on whether she is a practising Christian, a finding needed before assessing objective fear.
issues.respondent_position: Lack of credibility was determinative; the Board's finding that she was not in an underground church was reasonable.
issues.result_quote: I am of the view that the Board made a reviewable error.

issues.issue: Did the Board misconstrue the evidence on the seized Bible and the interpreter's translation?
issues.applicant_position: Applicant said the PSB only got hold of her Bible, so no receipt was expected; Qian affidavit supports this.
issues.respondent_position: Original interpreter's translation should be preferred; the Bible receipt finding is one minor point.
issues.result_quote: Because of my finding on this issue, I will not decide the remaining issues.

issues.issue: Did the Board err in failing to consider the employer's dismissal letter?
issues.applicant_position: Board had to expressly assess the employer letter, which corroborates underground church practice and contradicts its main finding.
issues.respondent_position: Letter lacked testimony or reliable support, so little weight; Board need not mention all evidence.
issues.result_quote: Because of my finding on this issue, I will not decide the remaining issues.
